title: Exams
subtitle: Exam and homework folders, built from the question bank

types.examHint: Question order changes per student; the admin sets a duration

modes.manualHint: You pick the questions from the bank
modes.randomHint: You set folders and counts per difficulty; the system draws

search.placeholder: Search by exam name or serial

folder.empty: No exam folders yet. Start by creating one.
folder.emptyFolder: This folder is empty. Add an exam or a subfolder.
folder.archiveConfirm: Archive the folder "{{name}}" and everything in it? Its exam links close; results are kept.

exam.publishedMismatch: Published, but the total {{total}} differs from the target {{target}}
exam.archiveConfirm: Archive the exam "{{name}}"? All its links close; results are kept.

settings.name: Exam name
settings.description: Description (optional, shown on the start page)
settings.serialHint: A number you type, for search and filtering
settings.subject: Subject
settings.durationHint: Leave empty to keep the exam open until the end date
settings.targetTotalHint: You get a warning when the total differs
settings.redoPercentHint: Below it, a redo opens for the student. Leave empty for no redo
settings.maxRedosHint: The most times a student can redo
settings.shuffleHint: Order changes per student inside each section; passage questions move together
settings.redoRequiredHint: The student sees "Redo required" until they redo or run out of attempts
settings.redoNewHint: A student who redoes gets new questions drawn with the same rules
settings.showAnswers: Show the right answers to the student
settings.showAnswersHint: Until then the student sees only their mark and which questions were right or wrong.

showAnswersOptions.after_last: After the last attempt (no redos left, or the exam ended)

sections.deleteConfirm: Delete this section with its questions and rules?

questions.totalMismatch: The total differs from the target
questions.added_zero: All picked questions are already in the exam
questions.matchingMark: Starts at one mark per pair; change it and it is shared equally between the pairs
questions.emptyManual: No questions in this section. Click "Add questions" and pick from the bank.
questions.emptyRandom: Nothing drawn yet. Save the rules, then click "Draw questions".
questions.redrawConfirm: Drawing again replaces the current questions. Past attempts are not affected. Continue?

rules.foldersHint: A folder includes all folders inside it
rules.categoryHint: Questions without a category are drawn only by rules without one
rules.matchingHint: A matching question takes its level's mark like any other, shared equally between its pairs
rules.title: Draw rules
rules.drawnHint: These questions were drawn with the rules above, and they are what students answer. After changing the rules, press Save rules, then Re-draw to change them.

picker.title: Add questions from the bank
picker.pickFolder: Pick a folder to see its questions

testLink.intro: An admin test link to try the exam as a student, with a start and end date. Teacher links are in the "Teachers & links" tab.
testLink.publishFirst: The exam isn't published, so the link won't open until you publish it.

bands.greatAnimation: Confetti rain, fireworks and a trophy
bands.perfectAnimation: Fireworks, golden rain and a crown
bands.failNote: No celebration or sound: an encouraging message, with the redo button when one is open.

sounds.intro: Bands and their ranges are fixed. Add any number of sounds to each band; one plays at random with the celebration.
sounds.none: No uploaded sounds, so the built-in sound plays

start.warning: Don't leave full screen or switch to another tab or app during the exam.
start.redoRequired: You're required to redo this exam
start.waitGrading: Your answers are waiting for grading; the result shows after.
start.finished: You have no attempts left in this exam.

take.multiWarning: This question has more than one correct answer. Pick all of them.
take.matchingHint: Tap an item, then its match in the other column, to draw a line. Tap a joined item to remove its line.
take.addPhoto: Add a photo of your answer
take.lastMinute: One minute left; your answers are submitted when time runs out
take.backToFullscreen: Go back to full screen to continue the exam.
take.submitAll: You answered every question. You can't change your answers after submitting.
take.submitUnanswered_one: 1 question has no answer. You can't change your answers after submitting.
take.submitUnanswered_other: {{count}} questions have no answer. You can't change your answers after submitting.
take.submitFlagged_one: 1 question is flagged as unsure. Review it before submitting.
take.submitFlagged_other: {{count}} questions are flagged as unsure. Review them before submitting.
take.unsaved: No connection: your latest answers are not saved yet. Keep this page open; they save as soon as you are back online.
take.takenOver: This exam was opened in another tab or device, so saving stopped here. You can continue here and the other place will stop.
take.serialHint: If something is wrong with this question, send this code to your teacher
take.flagHint: The question number turns yellow in the bar so you can come back before submitting
take.autoSubmitNotice: Your answers will be submitted automatically when time runs out. {{time}} left

result.pending: This exam has essay questions; the result shows after they are graded.
result.autoSubmitted: Your answers were submitted when time ran out.

headline.fail: That's okay, next time will be better

message.fail: Don't worry: look at the questions you missed and you'll find you're closer than you think.
message.pass: You passed the exam. Keep going.
message.good: A very good result. Keep it up.
message.perfect: Every answer right. An outstanding result!

result.answersHiddenRedo: The right answers show once your attempts are over. For now you can see which questions you missed, then redo the exam.
result.answersHiddenLater: The right answers are not shown yet; your teacher decides when.
result.sharing: Making the video... stay on this page
result.shareDownloaded: The video was saved to your device
result.shareFailed: This browser cannot make the video

grading.done: Grading complete; the student can see the result
grading.invalid: Check the marks: each is from 0 to the question mark, in halves
grading.left_one: One essay still has no mark
grading.running: The student is still taking the exam; grading opens after they submit.

teachers.addOnExam: Add a teacher on this exam only
teachers.search: Search by name, email or phone
teachers.datesHint: These dates apply to all of this teacher's links here; one link can be changed on its own later.
teachers.folderHint: Each teacher here has a permanent link on every exam in this folder, now and later.
teachers.zipEmpty: This teacher has no exams in this folder
teachers.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}}? Their links close; results are kept.
teachers.examHint: Teachers who have this exam (added on it or on a folder above it), each with the link students take it through.
teachers.notPublishedHint: The exam is not published, so links will not open for students until you publish it.

reopen.title: Reopen the exam for {{name}}
reopen.hint: Minutes go to the running attempt if there is one, otherwise to the next attempt.

teacher.title: My exams
teacher.subtitle: Exams the admin gave you, each with your own link and QR.
teacher.empty: No exams have been added for you yet.
teacher.searchStudents: Search by name, phone or serial
teacher.randomHint: A random exam: each student draws questions by the same rules; this is a sample.
teacher.search: Find an exam by name or serial

assistant.title: Teachers they assist
assistant.hint: The assistant sees these teachers' exams, students and results exactly as they do.
assistant.search: Search for a teacher to link

cover.title: Cover photo
cover.hint: Students see it at the top of the exam start page, with your photo and name.

appeals.title: Appeals
appeals.subtitleTeacher: Your students' appeals on questions: accept with a new mark, or reject with a reason.
appeals.subtitleAdmin: Every appeal from every link, the admin test link included.
appeals.formHint: Write why you think your mark should be higher; you can add up to 3 photos.
appeals.empty: Write a reason or add a photo
appeals.sent: Your appeal was sent to the teacher
appeals.acceptedLine: Accepted: mark changed from {{from}} to {{to}} out of {{max}}

preview.hint: A preview of the exam as a student sees it, with the right and model answers. Nothing is saved.
preview.hintRandom: A preview as a student sees it, with the answers. The exam is random: each student draws questions by the same rules; these are the questions drawn now.
preview.empty: This exam has no questions yet.

cancel.button: Cancel the question (everyone gets its mark)
cancel.confirm: Cancel this question? Every student who took it gets its full mark, and those whose score goes up are notified.
cancel.restoreConfirm: Restore the question? Students go back to the mark they had on it before.

mine.title: My exams
mine.subtitle: Every exam and homework you took, and how you do in each subject

parent.title: Children's exams
parent.subtitle: Your child's exams and homework, marks and level in each subject
parent.noChildren: No children linked to your account yet
parent.linkChild: Link your child from your profile
parent.answersHidden: The right answers show once your child can see them

export.title: Export results
export.subtitle: Pick one or more exams and the columns. One row per student, and a column per attempt of each exam.
export.search: Search by name, serial or folder
export.teachersHint: No teacher picked means every student
